text:
The Finn–Cara adjacency and the single slot between Cara and Gus leave only two blocks: Gus–Finn–Cara, or Finn–Cara–(someone)–Gus.

Gus before Ben, Ben before Dev, and Dev before Ivo, together with Ben–Gus and Ben–Dev each at least three slots apart, force a chain that only fits the first block and only when it starts in slot 1. The same separation rules then fix the rest: Ben in 4, Dev in 8, Ivo in 9, Hana in 7 (the only open slot at least three from Ben), and Ann in 5 (the only open slot at least three from Dev). Elif takes the remaining slot 6, which is after Cara. The other block cannot place Dev and Ivo inside slots 1–9, and every other placement of the first block breaks a separation or an order constraint.
